components.mechanism_note: Art. 27.3.5 grants the leave itself ('one-semester paid leave'); its pay is drawn only from the member's accrued sick leave and then the Sick Leave Bank (c2, c3), a different mechanism and payer, so the leave and its pay are separate components (V4; schema paid_duration). 'unpaid_leave' names the leave, not zero income. R1d: own sick leave then a member-funded bank with no employer shortfall stated -> no employer-paid weeks (the UMass Lowell MSP example in R1d). notes: Reference date 2018-06-25. Governing document: the 2014-2017 MSP agreement (2018_01). Its Art. 37.3 keeps it in force until a successor is executed. The 2017-2020 successor (2018_09) was ratified by members on 2018-06-25 (2018_00), but Art. 37.4 says it was entered into on 2018-08-01, and Art. 37.1 makes its terms effective on execution, so it was not in force on the reference date. Its Art. 27.3 (sick leave, parental leave, TDY postponement, leave without pay) and Art. 27.13 match 2018_01 for tenure-stream faculty. The changes are the NTT eligibility wording ('University service') and the extension of the TDY delay to librarians' continuing-appointment review. The summary of changes (2018_08) lists no parental-leave change. No-policy check (`missing`): a governing document for faculty leave (the collective agreement) is saved, so missing = false.

2018_01 includes image-only Memorandum of Agreement pages (PDF pp. 145-149, Oct 29, 2014): salary, funds, NTT parental-leave eligibility reduced to three years for Boston, Sick Leave Bank draws over 60 days; no change for tenure-stream parental leave.

Article 27.3.5 calls the parental leave a 'one-semester paid leave', but it is paid only from the member's own accrued sick leave and then the member-funded Sick Leave Bank. No employer shortfall is stated, so the paid figures are 0 (R1d; the rule's UMass Lowell MSP example has the same structure). The leave (c1) counts as protected leave (U3). The provisions recorded for staff (c20-c23) come only from the HR page and are flagged summary_only.

Chain, birth parent: parental leave of one semester (c1), with pay inside it from own accrued sick leave (c2) and then the Sick Leave Bank (c3); FMLA 12 workweeks (c8) and the Massachusetts maternity/parental leave of 8 weeks (c9) run alongside from the start of c1. Sick leave (c4) and the bank (c5) may extend the leave only when medically indicated. TDY delayed one year (c13).

Chain, non-birth parent: the same parental leave of one semester (c1), with c2 then c3 inside it; FMLA (c8) and the Massachusetts leave (c9) run alongside from the start of c1. TDY delayed one year (c13).

Not determined from the documents: the Massachusetts statute's text and service requirement (not saved; the 8-week length comes from a 2019 HR capture); the length of each member's sick-leave balance; whether the Provost form's chair, dean and provost approvals can refuse an eligible request (the agreement says 'shall receive' upon request).
